_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P0 operational targets.

requirements.title: Content-addressed intake
requirements.description: Files keyed by content hash; identical bytes are never stored or derived twice

validation.notes: Content-addressed repeat submission proves one document and one blob; test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-001].

requirements.title: Type and scan verdict
requirements.description: Real MIME sniffing plus a text-native vs scanned decision, recorded before any parse runs

validation.notes: Content sniffing distinguishes OOXML/ODF/EPUB ZIP families; test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-002].

requirements.title: Two intake paths
requirements.description: API/CLI upload and a watched directory, both idempotent under repeat submission

validation.notes: Ingest records the PDF classifier verdict before downstream parsing; test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-003].

requirements.title: Tier-1 native parse
requirements.description: Text-native PDFs parsed locally with no AI call and no network egress

validation.notes: The intake PDF verdict test exercises the local text-native classification path; the installed resource CLI is additionally proven by the Phase 15 operator proof. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-004].

requirements.title: Local structural parse
requirements.description: Word, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, presentations, spreadsheets, delimited text, HTML/XML, Markdown and plain text parsed locally through the declared handler chain for their format

validation.notes: The handler registry projection test covers the declared local structural format matrix. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-005].

requirements.title: One normalized document model
requirements.description: Every tier emits the same canonical model; consumers cannot tell which tier ran except by reading metadata

validation.notes: The derivation test proves a normalized unit model is emitted through the handler boundary. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-006].

requirements.title: Derivation versioning
requirements.description: Each derivation records tier, resource version and model role under a monotonic version; re-derivation never overwrites a prior version

validation.notes: The derivation test proves monotonically increasing versions and append-only results. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-007].

requirements.title: Stable unit anchors
requirements.description: Every unit carries a document hash plus the coordinates its handler chain could prove — page and bounding box, sheet and cell range, or structural path and character offset

validation.notes: The derivation test proves normalized units retain their anchor kind and coordinates. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-008].

requirements.title: Anchor resolution survives re-derivation
requirements.description: Geometric and tabular anchors minted against v1 resolve unchanged after v2; a logical anchor resolves through a recorded alignment or reports unresolved, never a wrong region

validation.notes: The resolver test proves re-derivation outcomes are explicit and never guessed. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-009].

requirements.title: Gateway-only inference
requirements.description: Zero direct provider calls; ai-conformance reports L2 on all four capabilities

validation.notes: The AST exclusivity test proves outbound inference uses one construction site. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-010].

requirements.title: Embedding metadata recorded
requirements.description: Role, model, dimension, content-version and retarget strategy stored alongside every vector from the first migration

validation.notes: The embedding test proves role, model, dimension, content version and retarget metadata are persisted. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-011].

requirements.title: Privacy class per document
requirements.description: Every document carries a PrivacyClass, and that class selects the gateway routing profile rather than a user setting

validation.notes: The sensitivity test proves privacy classification determines a tier ceiling without silently selecting a tier. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-012].

requirements.title: Fail-closed on sensitive documents
requirements.description: Confidential and secret documents never route remote; enforced in code, covered by a test asserting the failure, and visible in the UI

validation.notes: The policy table asserts confidential and secret classes reject weaker profiles. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-013].

requirements.title: Per-document processing receipt
requirements.description: Record of every derivation and inference step: tier, provider, locality, profile, privacy class and timestamps

validation.notes: The custody test proves a per-document receipt contains the processing record and locality/profile fields. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-014].

requirements.title: Immutable audit trail
requirements.description: Append-only custody records; no verb rewrites or deletes one, and document deletion tombstones rather than erasing the trail

validation.notes: The custody test proves the append-only journal retains its record while constructing a self-attested receipt. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-015].

requirements.title: Artifact store under declared budgets
requirements.description: Bytes and derivations registered as storage-manager kinds with explicit retention and a regenerable flag per kind

validation.notes: The lifecycle e2e test exercises the scenario's real routed storage/bootstrap path; storage-manager validation proves declaration correspondence. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-016].

requirements.title: Full corpus export
requirements.description: Whole corpus exports to an open documented format with no proprietary container and no lock-in

validation.notes: The corpus test proves open archive export/import preserves documents and anchor URIs. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-017].

requirements.title: search-hub provider registration
requirements.description: Registered and active so corpus content is discoverable from federated search. Because the federation contract carries no caller identity, exposure is per-collection opt-in (default off) with a hard ceiling: confidential and secret units never federate regardless of the flag

validation.notes: The registration test proves the scenario-local descriptor boundary without embedding a provider client; active search-hub registration remains governed by the runtime dependency. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-018].

requirements.title: Anchor kind recorded and honored
requirements.description: Every anchor carries geometric, tabular or logical from the first migration, recording the kind its handler chain could actually prove; resolution dispatches on kind and never reads a prunable parse output

validation.notes: The anchor test round-trips geometric, tabular and logical kinds and preserves the declared kind. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-019].

requirements.title: Connect-RPC with CLI parity
requirements.description: Every domain verb defined in proto; the CLI is a thin generated wrapper rather than a second implementation

validation.notes: The proto parity test proves every domain RPC has exactly one Connect endpoint descriptor. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-020].

requirements.title: The Reader surface
requirements.description: Side-by-side source page and derived units with bidirectional anchor highlighting and per-unit tier and confidence display

validation.notes: The Reader page test covers anchored results, locality, partial state and keyboard traversal. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-021].

requirements.title: Lifecycle and test compliance
requirements.description: setup/start/test/stop through the control plane with test-genie green including the ai-conformance phase

validation.notes: The lifecycle e2e test boots the real API through lifecycle-managed environment and verifies health; the comprehensive Test Genie run is the suite-level proof. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-022].

requirements.title: Corpus retrieval
requirements.description: Hybrid query over units — FTS5 lexical plus in-process cosine over SQLite-resident vectors, fused by reciprocal rank — returning results that each carry a resolvable anchor, and degrading to lexical-only with the index marked partial when embeddings are unavailable

validation.notes: The retrieval test proves deterministic hybrid lexical/semantic RRF ranking. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-023].

requirements.title: Privacy-filtered retrieval
requirements.description: A unit never surfaces in a query whose caller cannot read its collection or privacy class; asserted as a failure, not a filter applied late

validation.notes: The retrieval test proves privacy filtering precedes both scoring legs and excludes confidential results. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-024].

requirements.title: Collection default privacy class
requirements.description: A collection confers a default class that documents inherit on intake; a document may be classified more restrictively, never less

validation.notes: The corpus test proves collection privacy inheritance rejects a less restrictive document class. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-025].

requirements.title: Single gateway-request choke point
requirements.description: Every outbound GatewayRequest is built at one construction site that refuses a profile weaker than the document's privacy class, asserted by an AST check

validation.notes: The gateway request test proves confidential documents fail closed for a remote profile. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-026].

requirements.title: Unsupported is a terminal state, not a rejected upload
requirements.description: Bytes are retained and a custody record written for a document nothing can parse; it surfaces carrying one of no_handler_for_format, handler_unavailable, handler_failed, blocked_by_policy or unsupported_variant, each naming its own reason and remedy, and partial success records which capability was skipped

validation.notes: The derivation test enumerates the five distinct terminal states and their remedies. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-027].

requirements.title: Canonical anchor URI
requirements.description: Every citation is a vrooli-anchor: URI carrying content address, derivation version, anchor kind and coordinates, minted only in canonical form and compared by byte equality; resolution returns one of six outcomes and never a guessed region

validation.notes: The anchor tests cover canonical round-trip, non-canonical rejection, and all six resolution outcomes. Test carries [REQ:DOC-P0-028].
